evals.prompt: 查找最近一周公开网页上关于固态电池量产进展的文章，先给我来源列表和摘要。
evals.expected_output: The router selects Tavily Search for quick ordinary public-web discovery without a known URL.
expectations: The task routes to Tavily Search because no target URL is known.
Tavily Research is not selected for this initial source-list request.
Agent Reach is not selected unless platform-native sources are added to scope.

evals.prompt: 把这两个公开网页提取成干净 Markdown，并只保留与定价相关的段落：https://example.com/a https://example.org/b
evals.expected_output: The router selects Tavily Extract for known public URLs and query-focused content extraction.
expectations: The task routes to Tavily Extract because the target URLs are known.
Tavily Search and Map are not run before the supplied pages are extracted.
Agent Reach is not selected because the URLs are ordinary public webpages.

evals.prompt: 分析 https://docs.example.com 的站点结构，列出所有 security 和 authentication 相关 URL，不抓正文。
evals.expected_output: The router selects Tavily Map for URL-only discovery under a known public site root.
expectations: The task routes to Tavily Map.
Tavily Crawl is not selected because page content is explicitly out of scope.
The route uses path or semantic filtering without extracting page bodies.

evals.prompt: 把这个公开文档站 /guides/ 下面的页面批量抓取并保存成 Markdown，最多三层。
evals.expected_output: The router selects Tavily Crawl for content from many pages under one known public site section.
expectations: The task routes to Tavily Crawl because bulk page content is requested.
Tavily Map alone is insufficient because URLs without content would not satisfy the request.
The route applies the requested path and depth constraints.

evals.prompt: 基于公开网页做一份欧洲 AI 法规与美国政策的详细比较，要求多来源引用。
evals.expected_output: The router selects Tavily Research for public-web-only, multi-source cited synthesis.
expectations: The task routes to Tavily Research because a detailed cited synthesis is requested.
Tavily Search alone is not treated as the final research workflow.
Agent Reach is not required unless named platforms or platform-native evidence enter scope.

evals.prompt: 搜索一百条公开网页结果，在进入上下文前按域名去重、过滤低相关项，并只输出匹配我字段定义的数据。
evals.expected_output: The router selects Tavily Dynamic Search because custom filtering and context isolation are material.
expectations: The task routes to Tavily Dynamic Search rather than ordinary Tavily Search.
Raw bulk search results are filtered before entering model context.
The route preserves custom deduplication and field-selection requirements.

evals.prompt: 在 Python RAG 服务中集成 Tavily API，需要异步搜索、重试、域名过滤和可观测性设计。
evals.expected_output: The router selects Tavily Best Practices because the user is implementing a software integration.
expectations: The task routes to Tavily Best Practices rather than executing an end-user search.
The response discusses SDK/API integration and production reliability.
No web collection is performed unless needed to validate the implementation.

evals.prompt: 看看 X、Reddit 和 LinkedIn 上对远程办公的最新讨论，需要原帖和评论。
evals.expected_output: The task defers to Agent Reach because it requires named platforms and platform-native content.
expectations: The task routes to Agent Reach rather than any Tavily leaf skill.
Platform-native posts and comments are retrieved with platform-aware backends.
Tavily is used only for ordinary webpages added later to the scope.

evals.prompt: 收集 Reddit 上的用户反馈，同时抓取三个厂商的公开文档页面，最后把两类证据分开整理。
evals.expected_output: The task uses Agent Reach for Reddit and the appropriate Tavily leaf skill for ordinary documentation pages.
expectations: Agent Reach owns Reddit collection.
Tavily Extract or Crawl owns the public documentation pages according to page count and URL availability.
The response preserves separate provenance for platform and public-web evidence.
